how_to_run: Tiers: run every 'core' eval for any release that changes the skill's behaviour; run a 'topic' eval only when its area changes (the 'when' field); 'retired' evals are kept for their history and not run. Planted flaws the audit script should catch are tested without an agent: python evals/check_fixtures.py (also run in CI). For each agent eval, copy the listed kit folder (or fixture) into an empty scratch folder and give the prompt to a fresh agent with the skill installed; the agent must not see eval-kit/generator/expected/ or the fixtures' defect lists. Serve the result with the skill's scripts/preview_server.py (skills/academic-project-page/), run its scripts/audit.mjs, scripts/check_numbers.py and scripts/check_links.py, open the screenshots, and grade against expected_output, the expectations, and the trap answers in the answers file. Run a no-skill baseline for a new eval or a new rule; repeat a run rather than add an eval when one result looks like noise. All material is fictional and generated by eval-kit/generator (CC0). The set spans project types on purpose: a change that helps one eval and hurts another is overfitting.
